analysis.overall: You spent 74% of the day in range, but faced similar patterns at both dinner and breakfast where initial dips or low baselines were followed by stubborn spikes over 200 mg/dL.

events.title: Afternoon correction
events.description: After hovering at the bottom of your range near 76 mg/dL, a few small corrections brought you smoothly up to 163 mg/dL before leveling off.

events.title: Dinner spike after brief dip
events.description: Your 50g dinner bolus initially caused a quick dip to 75 mg/dL, but as the meal digested, glucose surged up to the day's high of 230 mg/dL.

events.title: Early morning low
events.description: The overnight corrections working on the late-night high eventually overshot, holding your glucose low around 63-68 mg/dL until 6:00 AM.

events.title: Post-breakfast high
events.description: Eating 50g of carbs starting from a low baseline of 70 mg/dL triggered a rapid rise, keeping levels above 200 mg/dL through mid-morning.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Notice how larger meals are digesting relative to your insulin timing, as both 50g carb entries led to late post-meal spikes.
